probe_note: Each host is fetched with fetch(no-cors) on /, /favicon.ico and /robots.txt; a host is blocked only when every path fails. The headline is a weighted module score, so the strict list must cover every scored host for all request types.

hosts.note: The probe tests only the /rtrg path; a host-wide rule would block the whole social network. The bundled EasyList path rule covers it.
